dateOffsetRules.beneficiaryBirthDates: Hospital-local anchor date minus seeded whole-year ages; minors 1-17, adults 18-70.
dateOffsetRules.availabilityStart: UTC anchor plus 7 days plus 2 hours per slot index.
dateOffsetRules.availabilityDuration: 30 minutes per slot; per-doctor intervals are non-overlapping.
dateOffsetRules.appointmentDate: Appointment slots inherit their deterministic availability UTC instants.
dateOffsetRules.createdUpdatedAt: Fixed benchmark clock anchor for seeded database timestamps.

protocol.database: fresh isolated SQLite database populated from the deterministic fixture per operation
protocol.measuredDuration: Client-observed request and response-envelope parsing; setup/reset excluded.
